title: NYBG's Botanical Art Program
content: Veronica Lawlor, Watercolor, gouache, and fountain pen,painted almost entirely with aConnoisseur Protege 9467 travel brushBesides being a leading public garden, the NYBG is an art school for plant lovers, with dozens of courses and weekend workshops on everything from “Plant Morphology for Botanical Artists” to “Daylilies in Colored Pencil and Watercolor.”They were the first to offer a certificate program in Botanical Art & Illustration. For more info, here's their website:NYBG Botanical Art and Illustration.Veronica Lawloris a pastel artist and urban sketcher and she teaches at Parsons andPratt.
